Minimal Unitree RL Lab deployment support, copied from revision
4960b84732b0c2ec593dccbfe963fda1bcd7b1e3: FSM, Passive, joystick DSL,
and G1 DDS aliases. The Apache-2.0 licence is retained in LICENCE.
Keyboard helpers, RL/Mimic states, policy loaders and ROS2 are not included.
This directory is ordinary source, not a submodule. Unitree SDK2 is a separate
system dependency (find_package(unitree_sdk2)).
